items.quote: And it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that, behold, Rebekah came out
items.claim: Rebekah came out before the speaker had finished speaking.

items.quote: Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder
items.claim: When Rebekah came out, she was carrying a pitcher on her shoulder.

items.quote: Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel
items.claim: Rebekah was the daughter of Bethuel.
Bethuel was the son of Milcah.
Milcah was the wife of Nahor.
Nahor was Abraham's brother, so Rebekah was Abraham's great-niece through Nahor and Milcah.
